subject: Proposal: Amendment for Additional GPU Capacity and SOW Alignment
messages:
From: Samir Kahn <s.kahn@omnitech.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@omnitech.com>, Theresa Lung <theresa.lung@omnitech.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: increase capacity + SOW edits for Q3

Hi Laura,

We reviewed our forecast for Q3 and need to request an amendment to our Order Form to add 6 additional A100-equivalent GPU slots (on dedicated pools) starting 2026-07-01. This will impact committed units and push us into the next pricing tier — we'd like to understand the commercial delta.

Separately, our engineering team needs the SOW Appendix B updated to include throughput SLAs (99th pct latency target, KV cache behavior) and a data retention clause specifying 90 days for ephemeral logs and customer-managed retention for PII.

I've attached a short summary of requirements and our procurement checklist. Please confirm next steps and an estimated timeline for a redline.

Attachments: OmniTech_Capacity_Request.pdf (summary)

Thanks,
Samir Kahn
Head of ML Platforms
OmniTech Systems
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Kahn <s.kahn@omnitech.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: increase capacity + SOW edits for Q3

Hi Samir — thanks for the details and the list.

Quick summary / next steps from our side:
- I'll draft an amendment to the MSA/Order Form that captures the added capacity, the adjusted monthly commitment, and a revised price table.
- Marcus will scope the SOW Appendix B edits with your engineering notes and propose SLA language.
- We'll route the draft to legal for redlines and then to your procurement for signature.

Target timeline: draft to you by EOD Tue 6/15, legal review Wed, aim for signatures by end of next week if there are no major open items. If the price delta requires finance approval, there may be a slight delay — we'll flag early.

Attached: Proposed_Amendment_OMN-98742_v1.docx (initial commercial draft)

Can you confirm the proposed start date of 2026-07-01? Also, do you have any mandatory billing/legal language from your side (PO terms, travel or export controls) that we should preemptively include?

Best,
Laura Bennett
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2026 13:48:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: Draft amendment & SOW notes (OMN-98742)

Laura / Mina — tagging you both. I attached my redline of the amendment focusing on Appendix B (SOW) changes and a suggested updated pricing table. Key technical asks from OmniTech:
- 6x additional A100-equivalent GPUs, dedicated pool, start 2026-07-01.
- Throughput SLA: 99th pct < 250ms for sub-512 token requests; 95th pct for > 2048 tokens to be described as throughput-tested.
- KV cache: preserve cold-start latency behavior; allow prefix caching for deterministic workloads.
- Data retention: 90 days for ephemeral logs; PII to be customer-managed or hardened with KMS.

Commercial items to confirm: monthly committed tokens vs burst, whether we keep them on the same billing cadence, and whether adding committed capacity triggers an annual pricing tier reset. I flagged the latter in the doc where finance signoff will be needed.

Attachment: redwood_proposed_amendment_v1_redline.docx (internal redline)

Marcus
Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2026 08:30:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Internal: Draft amendment & SOW notes (OMN-98742)

Thanks for the context. I reviewed the proposed amendment and have the following high-level legal items before we send externally: 

1) Indemnity and liability cap: the current MSA has a liability cap tied to annual spend. Increasing committed capacity materially may require recalibrating the cap or adding a carve-out for SOC/data breaches — propose we keep the cap but add a carve-out to avoid open exposure.
2) Data retention / PII: we should add explicit language that customer-managed PII is outside Redwood's control and require a shared responsibility paragraph; for logs, 90 days is OK but add an audit log retention clause and access SLA for compliance requests.
3) Price-tier reset: commercial changes that bump the account into a new tier should require Finance approval and a one-time re-pricing effective on the amendment effective date. I'll need a note from Finance specifying whether we apply tiered retroactive credits — flagging for contract ops.
4) Term and termination: if this amendment increases the committed term, ensure termination language is aligned (no auto-extension without explicit consent).

I made inline redlines and left comments where we need a commercial owner to state intent. Recommend we send OMN the redlined amendment with a short cover note summarizing the legal asks and that we can take comments in the next 48 hours.

Attachment: Legal_Redlines_OMN-98742.docx (legal redlines + comments)

I'll also loop in Finance if Marcus/Laura confirm the proposed commercial table.

Regards,
Mina Haddad
Senior Counsel, Contracts & Privacy
Redwood Inference
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Kahn <s.kahn@omnitech.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@omnitech.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2026 16:42:00 -0700
Subject: OMN-98742: Amendment v2 (for signature) & next steps

Hi Samir — thanks for the quick turnaround. Attached is Amendment v2 which incorporates the SOW Appendix B language (throughput SLA and KV cache notes), the 90-day log retention language, and the commercial table we discussed. Legal suggested a small carve-out to the liability cap for breach/forensic costs; we've called that out in section 7.2.

Summary of next steps:
- Please review the attached and let us know any redlines by EOD Thu 6/17.
- If there are no substantive legal changes, we will issue a DocuSign envelope for signature (links below).
- Expected effective date if signed within the week: 2026-07-01.

Attachments: OMN_Amendment_v2_for_signature.docx (final draft)

DocuSign (partner envelope): https://docusign.net/OMN-98742
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/98742
Drive (redlines): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cRedlines

If Procurement has PO requirements, please include the PO number in the DocuSign comment field so our billing team can match it.

Thanks — looking forward to closing this for Q3.

Laura Bennett

Redwood Inference
